import json, subprocess, sys
def run(doc):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/work/submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

# A: host PING on time, forward delivered exactly at deadline -> source finalizes by timeout
A={"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[4,4,4],
   "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
            {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
   "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":1,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
o=run(A)
print("A rounds:", o["rounds"])
print("A metrics:", {k:v for k,v in o["metrics"].items()})

# B: ACK arrives exactly at the deadline -> credited before timeout -> complete=true
B={"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[4,4,4],
   "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
            {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
   "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":4,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
o=run(B)
print("B rounds:", o["rounds"])
print("B classes:", o["classes"], o["summary"])

# C: ACK arrives one tick after the deadline -> timeout first -> complete=false
C=json.loads(json.dumps(B)); C["rounds"][0]["timeout_us"]=3
o=run(C)
print("C rounds:", o["rounds"])
print("C summary:", o["summary"])
EOF
